channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Smaller apps and faster GPU inference with LiteRT in Google Play services
item.description: LiteRT in Google Play services now offers GPU inference powered by ML Drift, delivering about 1.4x faster performance alongside the new CompiledModel API Switching from bundled binaries reduces app size by approximately 8 MB while enabling seamless, automatic runtime updates across billions of devices Developers can easily adopt these updates by updating their dependencies and utilizing the new Android Studio LiteRT skill for automated migration.

item.title: Hill-Climbing Agent Quality with Agents CLI Evaluation
item.description: This post walks through the Agents CLI evaluation loop for systematically improving agent performance through continuous testing and grading It demonstrates how to catch prompt regressions, evaluate model backend swaps using side-by-side trace comparisons, and automate evaluation passes Developers will also learn how to integrate nightly scheduled runs with threshold-based alerting to track quality over time.

item.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
item.description: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026 as attackers shifted to shorter, high-frequency strikes Explore the latest threat data, including the collapse of CLDAP vectors and the impact of recent botnet takedowns.

item.title: Meta Andromeda: Powering the Next Generation of Ads Retrieval Through Model-System Co-Design
item.description: This post describes the next generation of Meta Andromeda, Meta’s personalized ads retrieval engine, and how co-designing the model, system, and GPU hardware unlocks a new efficiency frontier for ads retrieval In production, the system scores every eligible ad with near ranking-level model performance at retrieval scale and surfaces the top candidates at over one [...] Read More The post Meta Andromeda: Powering the Next Generation of Ads Retrieval Through Model-System Co-Design appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
